snippet.title: Rune Runners – Official Trailer | 2-Player Couch Co-op Platformer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Rune Runners on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3556940/Rune_Runners/

Rune Runners is a colorful 3D platformer for one or two players on one couch. Pick two of four young mages, combine water, fire, thunder and wind, and relight the rune torches of eight worlds – past cute monsters, sneaky traps and eight big bosses.

Every level is made for two players on one screen: light the torches together, watch each other's back, pick your partner up when they go down, and step into the portal side by side. Nobody around to play with? Every level works solo too.

Wishlist now – it's the best way to support the game, and Steam lets you know as soon as the demo and the full game are out.

What's in the game
• 1–2 players: local co-op on one screen, or solo – Steam Remote Play Together for playing with a friend online
• 4 mages with water, fire, thunder and wind spells
• 8 worlds, 80 levels, 36 kinds of monsters and 8 bosses
• 3 runes per level and 142 hidden rune shards
• Relaxed, Normal and Heroic difficulty, switchable at any time
• Full controller support with Xbox, PlayStation and Switch button prompts, or keyboard
• Interface in 31 languages

Links
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3556940/Rune_Runners/
Discord: https://discord.gg/gs9m9EgUc

Rune Runners is made by Pierogi Games.
